claims.exact_statement: For arbitrary Boolean modules f_j(z,y_j) sharing one uniform separator z with mutually disjoint uniform private cubes, set J_j=(I(f_j|z0)+I(f_j|z1))/2 and fold each module by an optional selector character to delta_j=min(Inf_z(f_j),1-Inf_z(f_j)). With q_j=1-2delta_j>=0, delta_*=(1-product_j q_j)/2, Q_-j=product_(k!=j)q_k and kappa_j=I((a_j-b_j)/2) for the folded children, the folded product has private influence J=sum J_j and separator influence delta_*. Entropy and normalized-reference costs are unchanged by folding and original separator influence is at least delta_*. Its repeated-selector loss satisfies 0<=sum delta_j-delta_*<=J-delta_*, with optimal coefficient1 on J. Its exact derivative energy is I(D)=sum_j t_j, t_j=(1-Q_-j)J_j/2+Q_-j kappa_j<=J_j. Supplied finite normalized complete references of terminal costs c_0,c_1 admit a normalized root reference with CE_root<=(c_0+c_1)/2+(3/ln2)delta_*+2sum_j t_j. Thus exclusive per-module terminal allocations c_j,avg+2t_j<=KJ_j and K>=3/ln2 suffice for CE_root<=K I(original product). No universal terminal allocation or paired-row entropy-subadditivity statement is asserted.
hypotheses: Boolean signs on uniform physical cubes; entropy and CE in bits
Private blocks mutually disjoint and independent of the single common separator
Character folding permutes Fourier labels and normalized references; original physical influence retained in final conclusion
I(D) is L2 Dirichlet energy for a real derivative
Terminal references supplied, normalized, finite-cost; their complete CE is retained
All-r sharpness witnessed by a_j=1,b_j=private coordinate character
proof_dependencies: A097 compatible conditional-mixture reference lift; needed log-sum step reconstructed in REPORT section5
